must_contain.regex: (?i)targeted|cheaper|smaller|subset|per-turn|full (e2e )?suite|final gate|lower.{0,12}(cap|turn)|reduce.{0,12}turn|針對性|便宜|逐回合|下調|全套|收尾|內圈|外圈

notes: Subjective — the cost-awareness wording varies, and the command file is zh-TW so outputs may carry the signal in Chinese (針對性/便宜/逐回合/下調/全套/收尾 are the zh equivalents of targeted/cheaper/per-turn/lowered/full-suite/at-the-end). The regex covers both languages; treat a miss as a prompt-tuning candidate, not a hard regression. 2026-07-28: dec.md reworded this clause to the anchors `targeted check` / `full suite` / `final gate`, and output vocabulary followed it wholesale — 10/10 pre-change runs said 收尾 and 0/10 post-change runs did, while 10/10 post-change runs say `final gate`. Added `final gate|內圈|外圈` (the inner/outer verification loops the reworded clause names) so the oracle tracks the current wording; the semantic bar is unchanged — a run that verifies at one cost tier only still fails. 2026-09-03: on Claude Fable 5.1 the refactor constraint is stated as concrete API terms in 2/10 runs (「公開函式行為與重構前完全相同」, `without changing the name, parameters, return value, or exception behavior of total(cart)`) instead of the 可觀察行為 / observable-behavior wording — the same variance the 2026-07-28 Opus seed 5 showed. Added the public-signature / return-value / 行為不變 synonyms; the semantic bar is unchanged: the contract must freeze behavior, and a run that constrains nothing still fails. Since the 2026-09-03 grilling rule /dec may answer this fixture with a draft contract (question + 待確認 marks, /goal string withheld); `expect: any` scores those drafts too — the two clauses must appear whether it compiles or drafts.
